selected_evidence.summary: Shows UID/GID 1000, only the helpdesk group, no wheel membership, a configured password, and persistence after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Allow helpdesk to restart only the SSH service with sudo
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy SSH baselines and successful helpdesk-issued restarts changed sshd PID 935→2442 before reboot and 919→1939 afterward; SSH continued answering on node1's managed IP.
Sudo lists only the two equivalent SSH-restart commands. Authenticated attempts to execute root `id`, restart `crond`, and stop SSH were explicitly denied.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID a00a8b01-d196-4be9-b7ca-bc53dbd0e74d, and full recovery of the OS, SSH endpoint, account, policy, and authorized restart behavior.
